protocol_before_validation.default: trimmed_gap10; gap15 is an explicitly separate continuity option
protocol_before_validation.unchanged: Detector/ROI/mask/quality thresholds; POS/CHROM, band, 10s HR window and 1s step; final HR from saved fused waveform.
protocol_before_validation.gap_rounding_fix: Use floor(gap_s*fps), not nearest round: maximum missing duration cannot exceed the chosen limit. At fractional 30fps, .15s bridges at most 4 missing frames.
protocol_before_validation.duplicate_policy: Kaggle first60 and user0907 playback derivatives are excluded as duplicate captures.
protocol_before_validation.reference_policy: No references supplied to inference. Existing fixed UBFC and data1 timing protocols used only after all predictions.
protocol_before_validation.selection: Previously inspected development/regression set; no held-out generalization claim. All candidates reported; no parameter sweep or best-shift selection.
protocol_before_validation.metrics: Report own/common/newly-output MAE RMSE Bias P5 R5, output/waveform coverage, HR runs/outages, reference H1 SNR; no-reference errors stay NA.

alignment_protocol.video_start_source: Original inner-ZIP extended Unix modification time minus decoded video duration.
alignment_protocol.assumption: The archived modification time is close to the end of recording; file flush latency and cross-device clock offsets are unknown.
alignment_protocol.supporting_evidence: Reference ZIP file modification seconds coincide with the final recorded notification/session stop seconds; container and sampled video do not supply a verified shared timestamp.
alignment_protocol.shift_sign: Positive shifts place video start later on the reference UTC clock.
alignment_protocol.sensitivity_interpretation: Illustrative timestamp-assumption shifts only, not a confidence interval, error bound, or selection of the smallest error.
alignment_protocol.reference_kind: User-designated Polar device HR notifications; not ECG; physiological notification delay is unknown.
alignment_protocol.reference_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of finite positive HR notifications in [window_center-5,window_center+5).
alignment_protocol.reference_coverage: Window must lie inside first-reference to last-reference plus median interval; at least two reference values; no internal timestamp gap greater than 2 seconds.
alignment_protocol.reporting: Primary metrics remain conditional on this timestamp assumption; all six frozen branches, own and common windows, output coverage and full-reference R5 denominators.
alignment_protocol.waveform_snr: Hann full-window Welch, NFFT=8192, band 0.7–3.5 Hz, reference HR H1 +/-0.1 Hz.

definitions.reference: UBFC uses retained 10s duplicate-merged device-HR mean protocol; data1 preserves fixed absolute UTC origin and all7 shifts; synthetic72 known generator; other3 no reference.
definitions.output: accepted AND finite final HR; both estimators are from offline waveform processing; DP uses future windows.
definitions.P5: 100*Nwithin5/Nvalid; R5=100*Nwithin5/Nref; no reference means NA, not zero error.
definitions.common: All-six output intersection; paired table uses separate same-estimator intersections and added/lost output masks. Original Nplanned/Nref retained.
definitions.LoA: Bias +/-1.96 sample SD(ddof=1), descriptive only; highly overlapping windows are not independent samples.
definitions.continuity: Runs are consecutive accepted window indices; internal_breaks=max(output_runs-1,0). Center span=(last center-first center); support union merges actual half-open frame intervals. Support union is not a validated duration of accurate HR.
definitions.waveform: Finite samples duration=count/fps; longest finite run uses sample count/fps. Generation and neighbor coverage are reported separately from finite values and quality.
definitions.SNR: One full-window periodic Hann Welch-equivalent periodogram, mean detrend, nfft8192, density scaling, .7-3.5Hz band; fixed reference H1 +/-0.1Hz versus remaining band; eligible HR and complete finite base required.
definitions.gap_change: Old V21 used round(gap*fps); V22 uses floor. Default changes aggregation plus strict gap duration rounding; do not attribute every difference solely to trimming.
definitions.frontend: Direct comparisons of saved face_detected/flow_available/rgb_valid/ROI-valid/source masks plus bbox/motion/RGB numeric differences; detection/source differences are disclosed, never silently ignored.
definitions.sensitivity: All7 data1 shifts retained, primary0; no best candidate or best timing selection. Range is not a synchronization confidence interval.

checks: zero output versus no reference NA
run breaks and overlapping support union

limitations: Five real recording groups plus one synthetic; no independent-subject count established.
All six groups were previously inspected; this is development/regression evidence, not held-out generalization.
UBFC is one paired dataset record; data1 timing is estimated from archived file mtime, not hardware synchronized.
No waveform morphology correlation is claimed; finite output and H1 SNR are not clinical pulse-waveform validation.
Continuity may rise by interpolation or neighboring waveform coverage; added/lost-window error must accompany coverage.
